Question Choices: Select. A triangle has angles of 80 degrees, 45 degrees and 55 degrees. What type of triangle is it based on its angles? ~~Acute | Right | Obtuse~~
Hints: Check the angle total, then classify using the largest angle and any equal angles.
Solution: The angles total 80 + 45 + 55 =180 degrees. The largest is 80 degrees, below 90, so all angles are acute.
